n: Amii AI Literacy for K-12 Educators
t: A free AI literacy course and learning kits for K-12 educators from Amii in Alberta.
steps: Find the AI for All Essentials for Educators course on the Amii site.
Work through Chapter 1, What is AI.
Continue with Chapter 2, How AI Learns and Makes Decisions, and Chapter 3, Risks and Realities.
Look at the seven learning kits and choose one for your grade.
Request a kit through the Amii application page.
Ask your school board about loading a course package into the LMS.
